checks.label: bash
checks.detail: runs the drupilot scripts and hooks
checks.hint: Install bash >= 3.2 from your package manager

checks.label: jq
checks.detail: JSON parsing for hooks and preflight

checks.label: PHP
checks.hint: sudo dnf install php-cli  (or just use DDEV, which bundles PHP)

checks.label: Composer
checks.hint: https://getcomposer.org/download/  (inside DDEV you can use 'ddev composer' instead)

checks.label: Docker
checks.hint: Docker Engine: https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/fedora/  — then 'sudo usermod -aG docker $USER' and re-login

checks.label: Docker daemon
checks.detail: the engine must be running, not just installed
checks.hint: Start the Docker daemon (Linux: 'sudo systemctl start docker'; Desktop: launch the app)

checks.label: Selenium add-on
checks.hint: ddev add-on get ddev/ddev-selenium-standalone-chrome  &&  ddev restart

checks.label: SSH key
checks.hint: ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@example.com", then upload the public key at https://git.drupalcode.org/-/user_settings/ssh_keys and test with 'ssh -T git@git.drupal.org'

checks.label: GitLab PAT
checks.detail: HTTPS push / API token (alternative to SSH)
checks.hint: Create a token at https://git.drupalcode.org/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens (scopes: read_repository, write_repository) and export DRUPILOT_GITLAB_PAT=...

checks.label: git identity
checks.hint: git config --global user.name "Real Name"  &&  git config --global user.email you@example.com (the email linked to your drupal.org account)

checks.label: drupal.org account
checks.hint: Create/verify your account at https://www.drupal.org/user/register and accept the GitLab Terms of Service in your profile's 'DrupalCode access' tab

checks.label: glab/curl
checks.detail: open/manage MRs via the GitLab API (degradable)
checks.hint: Optional GitLab CLI: https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli  (curl is used as a fallback)
